outcome: Specific lipid metabolites in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 21 pregnant patients with gestational diabetes mellitus and 22 normal pregnant women.
finding: The study found 167 lipid metabolites in umbilical cord blood associated with GDM, with 13 specific dysregulated metabolites highlighted, mainly linked to glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism.
cross-section timing: Umbilical cord blood collection at birth
